ydmhcxhn.variantName: Christow Slim Snowy Cone and Berry Christmas Tree – 5ft
ydmhcxhn.sourceDescription: Short on space for a traditional Christmas tree? With its slim shape and winter forest look, our Pine Cone & Berry Pencil Christmas Tree is a stunning choice for corners and narrow spaces. This 5ft version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Lush Natural-Looking Branches: Green stems and a mix of soft PVC and luxury feel-real PE needles helps to capture the look and feel of a real evergreen. • Snow, Pine Cones & Berries: The pencil tree comes pre-decorated with artificial berries and real pine cones for an enchanting winter forest look. • Sturdy Plastic Stand Included: For immediate display, the tree comes complete with a sturdy plastic stand which is green to blend in with the foliage. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H150cm x W39cm x D39cm • Colour: Multi Coloured • Material: Plastic • Lights: Unlit • Tree shape: Slim • Weight: 2kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL

mebmsb9h.baseName: Walplus 276 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White - 511 cm
mebmsb9h.variantName: Walplus 276 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White - 511 cm
mebmsb9h.sourceDescription: This LED Christmas Tree with Spikes elevates your holiday decor with dynamic lighting patterns and a sleek modern design fit for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings. Designed for those looking to enhance their festive display, this tree blends seamlessly with a variety of settings, from living rooms to garden spaces. Artfully crafted from metal, it presents an enduring piece that withstands the seasonal wear and tear, adding a lively touch to your festive celebrations. Dynamic Lighting Effects The LED Christmas Tree offers dynamic lighting that continuously changes patterns, creating a captivating visual display. With eight modes, you can personalize how your tree lights up the holidays, turning ordinary moments into memorable events. USB-Powered Convenience This tree is engineered to be powered through USB, making it versatile and convenient for use without traditional power adapters. Simply plug it into any USB port, whether it's a power bank, computer, or adapter, for instant festive illumination. Durable Metal Construction Built with solid metal, the tree provides a robust structure that is abrasion resistant. This choice in material extends the product's life, even in high traffic locations, ensuring it remains part of your seasonal decor for many future gatherings. Versatile Use Suitable for both the living room and sheltered outdoor spaces like patios or terraces, this tree adapts well to various environments, offering consistent festive charm whether displayed in a cozy nook or open veranda. Simple Care and Maintenance To maintain its quality appearance, a simple wipe with a dry cloth is all it takes. This ease of maintenance heightens user convenience, allowing more time for enjoyment rather than upkeep. Product Specifications Colour: Warm white Material: Metal Tree height: 511 cm Durable Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 276 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Cable length: 500 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x LED christmas tree This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
